plot: At the beach in the morning Max wants to build the tallest sand castle, but a wave melts it, Dog digs a hole instead of a hill and Bird sits on the tower; Mouse explains wet sand sticks and to build away from the waves, Dog's hole becomes a moat and the castle survives with a gold star on top.

script.title: Can Max Build a Castle the Sea Can't Eat?

beats.say: Hey! Where did my castle go? It was right here!
It is a sunny morning at the beach. Max has one big dream today.
I want to build the tallest sand castle in the whole world!
The tallest in the world? That is very, very tall, Max.
Then I will start right now. Bucket, go!
Max fills the bucket. Pat, pat, pat. Flip!
Look! One tower already. This is easy!
But then, a big blue wave comes rolling up the sand.
Swish! The tower melts away like ice cream.
Oh no! My tower turned into a puddle!
The sea is hungry today. Maybe we can try again.
Did somebody say digging? I am the best digger ever!
Dog, can you help me make a big hill of sand?
Yes! Dig, dig, dig, dig, dig!
Sand flies everywhere!
Dog! The sand is flying on my nose!
Look, Max! I made a hole, not a hill!
A hole is the opposite of a castle, Dog.
Oops. Can I keep the hole? It looks so cozy.
Dog is already sleeping in it. That was fast.
This time my tower will touch the sky!
Max builds up, up, up. The tower is taller than Max!
Ooh, a tall tower! What a perfect place to sit!
No, Bird, wait! It is not ready for sitting!
Bird lands on top. The tower wobbles. Wiggle, wiggle.
Plop! Bird sits down in a soft pile of sand.
Three castles, and zero castles left. I give up.
Max, do not give up yet. I have been watching the sand.
Dry sand falls down like sugar. Wet sand sticks together.
And the waves only come this far. So we build up here.
Wet sand, far from the waves. Mouse, you are smart!
I can help! I will dig the moat around it!
Yes! A moat is a little river. That is a good hole, Dog!
And I will bring shells for the windows. I am fast!
The castle grows. One tower, two towers, three towers!
Then the big blue wave comes back.
Oh no. Here it comes. Hold on, castle!
But the wave stops far away. It only fills Dog's moat.
My hole has water in it now! Best hole ever!
It worked! The castle is still standing!
Now it needs one more thing on the very top.
Mouse gives Max a shiny gold star.
A star for the top! Now it is the tallest castle on our beach!
When things fall down, try a new way, and ask your friends.
Tomorrow I want to build a boat. Do you think it will float?
